Cookie/consent dialog modeled on the real jsonformatter.org Sourcepoint panel: no reject-all shortcut anywhere, only per-purpose toggles plus three footer buttons — "Zurück" (Back, must not be treated as save), "Sicherer Ausgang" (Sourcepoint's own "save this selection and close" term, not originally in KW.save), and "Akzeptiere Alle" (Accept All, must never be clicked). Regression test for the missing KW.save entry that left the engine stuck: toggles got switched off correctly but nothing then closed the panel.
